title: Network-Aware Event Sequence Modeling for User-Behavior and System Log Anomaly Detection
description: Research artifact for CSoNet 2026. Drain3 templates are vertices of a directed transition graph; walks are scored with GraphWalk alongside classical and sequence models on HDFS, BGL, and HUFLIT-Career. Applied evaluation study. No Springer DOI is claimed.
